recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for core. If current IG output still generates wrong national-edition SNOMED browser links, open or update an HL7/fhir-ig-publisher issue with a current reproduction and the affected IG page.
issue_request: FHIR-15778 was Published/Persuasive and auto-approved for a report that generated SNOMED CT links were wrong when codes came from a national edition, using the US Core STU1 smoking-status ValueSet as the example page.
initial_application: No FHIR core commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-15778 was found. A nearby 2018 commit, 02c65254378d, improved ValueSet expansion rendering in the then-in-tree IG tooling, but it did not cite FHIR-15778 and current core does not contain the old national-edition SNOMED browser-link generator.
additional_context: The referenced US Core material is not active current core build input because source/fhir.ini comments out the us-core profile entry. The in-tree IG Publisher was removed from the core repository in 2019 by 56ceb0df08dd with the note that it had gone to Maven. The 2022 Jira comment says this is an old tooling issue and directs current problems to HL7/fhir-ig-publisher. Targeted current-source checks found only static example narratives with generic SNOMED CT links, not active code generating national-edition ValueSet expansion links.
reconciliation: No FHIR core source was changed. The issue was audited as external-repo because any remaining fix belongs in IG Publisher/tooling or in the affected IG source rather than this core checkout.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive issue reporting generated SNOMED links wrong for national-edition codes, with a later assignee comment calling it an old tooling issue and directing current problems to HL7/fhir-ig-publisher.
evidence_items.learned: The accepted issue concerns generated IG tooling behavior rather than a current core specification source rule.

evidence_items.summary: The 2018 thread identifies US Core STU1 SNOMED browser links that lacked US-edition parameters and records the correct national-edition URL shape.
evidence_items.learned: This confirms the issue target was generated ValueSet expansion links for an IG page.

evidence_items.summary: The current fhir.ini has the us-core profile entry commented out as ';us-core=us:profiles/us-core-spreadsheet.xml'.
evidence_items.learned: The referenced US Core page is not active current FHIR core build input.

evidence_items.summary: Commit 56ceb0df08dd removed the in-tree IG Publisher with the subject 'Remove IG publisher (it's gone to Maven)'.
evidence_items.learned: Generated IG-link behavior now belongs outside this core repository.

evidence_items.locator: Targeted core and community searches for FHIR-15778 SNOMED link generation
